## MarketUtils.hash() function

Computes the HashLib market params struct hash.

Hashing canonicalizes non-empty collateral params by token order and preserves the protocol-zero empty market used for tree padding. It does not validate every market creation rule. Use [MarketParams](./midnight-sdk.marketparams.md) when constructing user-facing market params.

**Signature:**

```typescript
function hash(market: MarketInput): `0x${string}`;
```

## Example


```ts
import { MarketUtils } from "@morpho-org/midnight-sdk";

const hash = MarketUtils.hash({
  chainId: 8453,
  midnight: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000001000",
  loanToken: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000001",
  collateralParams: [
    {
      token: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000002",
      lltv: 770000000000000000n,
      liquidationCursor: 250000000000000000n,
      oracle: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000003",
    },
  ],
  maturity: 1n,
  rcfThreshold: 0n,
  enterGate: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000",
  liquidatorGate: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000",
});
console.log(hash);
```
